name: jumpserver-mcp
description: JumpServer (KoKo) bastion connector for WorkBuddy as an MCP stdio server: persistent SSH/PTY session with explicit state machine, asset discovery, permission-gated audited commands, target-affinity batch execution, fixed-profile structured host inventory, evidence-annotated topology, streaming jobs, and an embedded local ops console (live terminal mirror, topology / jobs / audit / stats / session tabs).
